subtitle: Vegan meals for strength and weight loss. Meal 1 and Meal 2 are the same dishes as Srinivas's, in lighter portions, plus a high-protein breakfast.
safety: Shared meals, smaller plate: take the same dishes as Srinivas but half the rice, roti or millet (1 roti instead of 2). Keep the full protein and fill up on extra vegetables and salad.
Protein: about 1.2 g per kg of body weight a day, spread over the three meals. Protein keeps you full and protects muscle while losing weight.

Soy and flaxseed: have soy foods (tofu, soy milk, soya chunks) and 1 tbsp ground flaxseed most days; they support women's health after 40. Spicy food, caffeine and alcohol can cause sudden warmth and sweating.
Bones: aim for calcium-rich foods every day: calcium-set tofu, fortified soy milk, ragi, sesame and leafy greens. Ask the doctor about vitamin D and B12, which are needed on a vegan diet.
No added sugar, jaggery or honey; whole fruit instead of juice. Nuts are healthy but calorie-dense: a small handful a day.
Finish dinner 2 to 3 hours before bed. Drink 2.5 litres of water a day; thirst is often mistaken for hunger.
Lose weight slowly, about ½ kg a week. Crash diets take away muscle and bone.
